scenario: H0 Moffett-to-Shoreline five-lane auxiliary candidate (not as-built)
additional_assumptions: This is a provisional lane-layout hypothesis, not a surveyed 2025 as-built roadway.
OSM edge 617335302 is modeled with five lanes, adding a right-side Moffett-to-Shoreline through/auxiliary lane.
The right-side upstream lane shares a Shoreline exit and through connection; the downstream lane shares a receiving lane with the Shoreline-side ramp.
No express-lane restrictions or full corridor lane-to-lane reconciliation are claimed for this sensitivity run.
